title: MIA Against Time Series Synthetic Data
summary: A research codebase implementing membership inference attacks (MIA) against synthetic time-series generators, using ECG-style patient data as the test domain. It trains and samples from SDV's PARSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer (via SingleTableMetadata) as the target generative models under attack, making SDV's synthesizers the core subject of the study.
